# Model Check

A **track** is one sequential line of work; steps in the same track never overlap, and anything that happens while something else happens belongs in a different track. A **step** has exactly one duration kind: `fixed` (a number of seconds), `variable` (a range with a default), or `indefinite` (runs until manually stopped). A **startTrigger** anchors a step to the clock (programStart, programStartOffset) or to another step (afterStep, afterStepWithBuffer, manual, onAbort, or compound logic). **stepId**s must be unique across the ENTIRE program, not just within one track. Every `task` that a step occupies must have a matching entry in `resourceConstraints` with a `maxConcurrent` value that prevents resource conflicts — e.g., one oven means `maxConcurrent: 1`. Work repeated n times (n loaves, n samples, n aircraft) is declared as `replicates` on a single step, never as n copied steps; downstream per-instance work uses `instances: "each"`, a barrier that waits for all instances uses `instances: "all"`, and when a holding area (cooling rack, sample rotor, taxiway) can only fit k items at once, `maxInFlight: k` holds the upstream step back so the downstream one does not starve.

For this country loaf recipe, I expect the following resource constraints:

| task | maxConcurrent | notes |
|------|---|---|
| prep | 1 | one baker doing all weighing, mixing, folding, shaping |
| bulk_fermentation | 1 | one bowl for bulk ferment (3–5 hours) |
| autolyse | 1 | flour + water resting (1 hour) |
| levain | 1 | one jar at room temperature (4–6 hours) |
| refrigerator | 1 | one fridge holding shaped boules overnight (10–14 hours) |
| oven | 1 | one oven for preheating and baking |
| dutch_oven | 1 | one Dutch oven; two loaves bake sequentially, 40 min each |
| cooling_rack | 1 | one rack where both loaves cool (1+ hour each) |

```json
{
  "acknowledgement": "tracks are sequential lines of work; one duration kind per step; triggers link steps; every task needs a resourceConstraint; stepIds are global",
  "resourceConstraints": [
    { "task": "prep", "maxConcurrent": 1 },
    { "task": "levain_jar", "maxConcurrent": 1 },
    { "task": "autolyse_bowl", "maxConcurrent": 1 },
    { "task": "bulk_ferment_bowl", "maxConcurrent": 1 },
    { "task": "refrigerator", "maxConcurrent": 1 },
    { "task": "oven", "maxConcurrent": 1 },
    { "task": "dutch_oven", "maxConcurrent": 1 },
    { "task": "cooling_rack", "maxConcurrent": 2 }
  ],
  "actors": 1
}
```
